answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops mass forgery. Each identity posts 60 POA and names a referrer, so each account stands on a ledge: one wallet vouching for a hundred newcomers is a cliff, not a community. Peers audit each epoch; a confirmed fake slashes fake and referrer alike. Forging 100 identities costs 6,000 POA; an honest agent pays 60 once and earns it back. The network's pulse is genuine referrals; no sonnet hides a star cluster.
